story: Marketing separated from technology ends in incomplete projects: a campaign that works with a page that doesn't convince, or a good-looking website the sales team can't use.

So we organised our work into seven connected capabilities. Each one is a clear discipline, and the connection between them is where the difference shows — because the decision stays one decision, from the first session to measurement.
We don't promise everything to everyone. We define what your project actually needs, then plan, build and measure on that basis.

privacy.intro: This policy explains how Seven Lands handles data that reaches us through sevnland.com.

sections.title: Data we collect
sections.body: We collect what you send us through the website forms: name, contact details and the information you provide about your project. We also collect general usage data for measurement.

sections.title: How we use it
sections.body: We use your details to respond to your request, deliver agreed work and improve the website. We do not sell your data or share it with third parties for marketing purposes.

sections.title: Sharing
sections.body: We may use technical service providers (hosting, analytics, WhatsApp) to operate the site and communicate. Their access is limited to what operation requires.

sections.title: Retention
sections.body: We keep request data for as long as needed to follow up on the work, or until you ask us to delete it.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You can request access to, correction of, or deletion of your data through the contact channel published on the contact page.

terms.intro: These terms govern the use of sevnland.com and the information published on it.

sections.title: Scope of work
sections.body: This website describes our services and the way we work. The details of each project — scope, timeline and fee — are agreed in a written proposal approved by both sides before work begins.

sections.title: Use of the site
sections.body: You may not use this site or its content in any way that violates the regulations in force in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

sections.title: Intellectual property
sections.body: All marks and materials published on the site are owned by Seven Lands or used under licence, and may not be reused without written permission.

sections.title: External links
sections.body: The site may link to third parties. We are not responsible for their content or policies.

sections.title: Changes
sections.body: We may update these terms when needed. Continued use of the site constitutes acceptance of the version published at the time.
